primary_consultations.finding: Article 19 lists 점박이 with 박다. Article 20 describes noun-to-noun 이 and lists 바둑이. Standard-language Article 8 identifies 흰둥이 with 둥이, creating a boundary conflict with the KRDict 이 example. These references do not classify all other bases.
The answer explicitly treats 바둑이 이 as a suffix; suffixation need not change the base word class.

primary_consultations.finding: The answer analyzes 못난이 using 못나다, adnominal ㄴ and bound noun 이. It conflicts with the suffix example and the newer primary answer.

The answer distinguishes 젊은이 as a lexicalized bound-noun formation and 못난이 as suffixal. It says surface form alone cannot settle the category and acknowledges competing analyses. Both older and newer answers remain evidence, without silently resolving the disagreement by date.
